# Immutable paw-seat reference

This test-only fixture retains the independently accepted 2026-11-22 whole-HF local-wrist actor and its original/sample-fitted basalt support construction. It is the geometry oracle for the later production rock/contact extraction, not a runtime asset or a proposed actor. The original 0.26-radian wrist, derived binding, cleanup and jewel height fit are deliberately fixed here; the production wrist/seam refinement is tested separately. Raw HF model and material provenance remains in `docs/bermuda_sleeping_titan_huggingface_redraw.md`.

These project-authored reference modules were copied unchanged in behavior into tracked fixtures for clean-checkout CI. Only relative imports and formatting were adjusted. Tests must not require ignored local experiment directories.
